method: Differential whole-file review: all changed hunks read against previously fully read Unix assembly; remaining lines verified text-identical with SequenceMatcher autojunk disabled. This is not an independent serial reread of identical lines. Full untruncated unified diff inspected.
findings: Windows entry saves RSI/RDI in addition to SysV callee-saved general registers, reserves880 bytes and aligns stack64. XMM6..15 lower128 halves are saved at aligned offsets0x2D0..0x360 and restored before return; upper YMM halves are volatile and cleared with vzeroupper.

Four Windows register arguments are reshuffled RCX/RDX/R8/R9 to internal RDI/RSI/RDX/RCX; counter at RBP+0x68, increment byte0x70, flags/start/end0x78/0x80/0x88 and output pointer0x90 account for eight pushes and caller shadow space.

Counter-low/high/mask/step/byte-length stack slots differ from Unix and all corresponding initialization, eight-way update and4/2/1 tail references are adjusted. Compression arithmetic and output widths are text-identical outside reviewed address changes.

Four-way prefetch instructions present in Unix are omitted here. Read-only section uses .rdata; ELF GNU-stack/CET and Apple conditionals are absent. No unwind metadata directives appear in this pinned source; Windows exception/unwind behavior is unqualified.
The same wider32-byte loads in paired tail inputs and nonzero-block precondition remain. Source equivalence does not establish actual Windows ABI correctness or runtime fault.
limits: No Windows/x86 execution, unwind test or speed measurement. Reference only; pHash/ASAN remains deferred.
